sectionHeadings: B-1. One comment, found by marker, never a thread
B-3. Absence is stated, never implied
B-4. The note never invents a verdict
B-5. Posting is not a gate
B-6. The note carries no credential
record.summary: This repository reviews locally. `/code-review` runs in the session, before the push, and its findings never leave the terminal: the pull request shows three green checks and no reasoning. The checks UI already reports what CI can know, so the gap is not a CI summary but the thing only the session holds, namely what the review found, what was fixed and what was accepted. This spec adds one sticky comment per pull request, updated in place on every push, carrying the head sha, what changed, the gate verdicts that actually ran, and the review's findings with their disposition. It is posted by the session, it never invents a verdict, and failing to post it never blocks a ship.
record.title: The review note: what the local cycle found, posted where the pull request can see it
